newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Safmarine expands Mediterranean coverage.
newsitem.headline: Safmarine expands Mediterranean coverage.

text.p: Shipping company Safmarine said on Monday it would expand its container services division to meet growing demand in Mediterranean countries, using the hub port of Gioia Tauro in Italy as a common depot.
The company said the growing demand for its services in the region stemmed from increased trade with countries in the region.
"There is definitely a demand in the market place for shipping services to and from 'new' or 'non-traditional' trading areas," Safmarine trade manager Alex de Bruyn said in a statement.
"In the recent past, there was little trade between South Africa and countries such as Egypt, Tunisia, Lebanon and Jordan. But that is all changing in the new South Africa," de Bruyn said

Containers would be transported by the Southern Africa Mediterranean Container Service, which is jointly operated by Safmarine and Italian shipping company Lloyd Triestino, to and from Gioia Tauro and then on carried weekly by Safmarine to Port Said, Alexandria, Haifa, Ashdod, Tunis, Beirut and Aqaba.
